meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: Claude 会把任务拆成极细的原子步骤,先按 define-goal 注册目标和成功标准,再逐步执行、把每一步同步进实时计划清单,产出带检查点的执行状态和绑定当前代码树的证据记录。
howto.when: 当你提到 ulw-loop、ulw 等关键词,或要求耐久、可检查点的长任务执行、手动 QA 时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 执行这个目标,先注册目标和成功标准
say.note: 会先建目标再进入执行循环

say.text: 看一下 ulw-loop 现在的状态和计划清单
say.note: 读取 .omo/ulw-loop 里的会话状态

say.text: 把这一步的证据记录并打检查点
say.note: 证据绑定当前代码树,变了要重跑

howto.what_en: Claude registers your goal and success criteria via define-goal, then runs the work as ultra-granular atomic steps mirrored into a live plan checklist, producing checkpointed state and evidence bound to the current git tree.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop, ulw, durable checkpointed long-running execution, or manual QA.

say_en.text: Run this goal with ulw-loop; register the goal and success criteria first.
say_en.note: It creates goals before entering the loop.

say_en.text: Show the current ulw-loop status and plan checklist.
Record evidence for this step and checkpoint it.
say_en.note: Evidence is bound to the current git tree.
